title: Do It Good
scene: Miami TK Records early disco and funk
notes: Punchy early Miami funk: whistles, brass, backing voices and spare, driving rhythms.

title: KC and the Sunshine Band
scene: Miami TK Records disco and funk
notes: Bright disco breakthrough with layered horns, guitar tape effects and commanding dance-floor hooks.

title: The Sound of Sunshine
notes: Instrumental Sunshine Band outing: syncopated guitar, brisk brass and rhythmic funk vamps.

title: Part 3
scene: Miami TK Records disco and funk
notes: A relentless horn-driven disco album, from Shake Your Booty to I’m Your Boogie Man.

title: Who Do Ya (Love)
scene: Miami TK Records disco-funk and disco-soul
notes: Percussive Miami disco-funk, Caribbean touches, prominent brass and a Four Tops reinterpretation.

title: Do You Wanna Go Party
scene: Miami TK Records disco-funk and orchestral soul
notes: Extended funk party grooves meet the restrained strings and harp of Please Don’t Go.

title: The Painter
scene: Miami Epic Records post-disco soul and pop
notes: Soul-oriented reset with soft tenor leads, bright synthesizers and arranged strings.

title: All in a Night's Work
scene: Miami Epic Records early-1980s disco and synth-pop
notes: Give It Up anchors a synth-brass dance record, softened by romantic duets and ballads.
